narrative.weekly_mirror: Teaching Vihaan the first twenty verses became more than repeating what you were taught: "I found myself explaining them properly". Later, your indigo work carried that same care into something distinctly your own, from almost-grey to deep navy, using a fermentation vat shaped by an old Kalamkari manual.
narrative.tension_explanation: You spent these days carrying family practices forward while also making room for your own curiosity and interpretation. The rangoli, the aloo paratha, the prayers, and your dye experiments each connect you with Appa, your grandmother, and the traditions you were raised with, without erasing your individual way of doing things.
narrative.reflective_question: When Vihaan asked what the verses meant, what did that change for you about how you wanted to pass them on?
